title: Distinguish longitudinal and transverse waves

hook.scenario: Agar aap ek slinky (spring) ko ek taraf se push aur pull karein, aur doosre case mein usko up-down hilayein, toh waves alag alag banti hain.
hook.question: Sound kis type ki wave hai?

mental_model.intuition: Longitudinal waves mein particles aage-peeche dhakka maarte hain (push-pull), jabki transverse waves mein particles upar-neeche ya side-to-side hiltay hain.
mental_model.description: Imagine log line mein khade hain; agar ek person dusre ko push karta hai, toh wave aage badhti hai (longitudinal). Lekin agar ek stadium mein log apni jagah par khade hokar 'Mexican wave' banate hain (upar-neeche), toh wo transverse wave hai.

prediction.question: Sound wave mein air particles kis direction mein move karte hain — wave ki direction mein (aage-peeche) ya wave ke perpendicular (upar-neeche)?
prediction.explains: Sound ek longitudinal wave hai — particles wave ki propagation direction ke PARALLEL oscillate karte hain (aage-peeche), perpendicular nahi. Isiliye compressions (paas-paas) aur rarefactions (door-door) bante hain.

reflection.prompt: Agar particles upar-neeche move kar rahe hote (perpendicular), toh compressions aur rarefactions ban paate ya nahi?
reflection.answer: Nahi ban paate! Compressions tab bante hain jab particles aage-peeche move karke ek jagah crowd ho jaate hain. Perpendicular motion se particles kabhi crowd nahi hote — woh transverse wave ka pattern hai (jaise rassi ki wave), longitudinal ka nahi.

diagram3d.caption: Longitudinal wave — particles aage-peeche oscillate karte hain (propagation ke parallel), compressions aur rarefactions banate hain.

poster.caption: Sound wave: particles aage-peeche hilte hain, compressions (paas-paas) aur rarefactions (door-door) banate hain.

explanation:
Waves generally do types ki hoti hain: **longitudinal waves** aur **transverse waves**.

**Longitudinal waves** mein medium ke particles wave ke travel karne ki direction ke parallel oscillate (vibrate) karte hain. Sound ek longitudinal wave hai. Jab sound hawa mein travel karti hai, toh air particles ek doosre ko push karte hain aur wapas apni jagah aate hain. Is push-pull ke wajah se hawa mein **compressions** (jahan particles paas hote hain, high pressure) aur **rarefactions** (jahan particles door hote hain, low pressure) bante hain.

Doosri taraf, **transverse waves** mein medium ke particles wave ki direction ke perpendicular oscillate karte hain. For example, jab aap ek rassi ko ek end se upar-neeche hilate hain, toh rassi ke particles up-down move karte hain lekin wave aage ki taraf travel karti hai. Light bhi ek transverse wave hai.

Board exams ke liye yaad rakhna zaroori hai ki sound ek mechanical wave hone ke saath-saath ek longitudinal wave bhi hai, isliye iske propagation mein compressions aur rarefactions involve hote hain.

key_points.title: Longitudinal Waves
key_points.detail: Particles oscillate parallel to the direction of wave propagation (e.g., sound waves).

key_points.title: Transverse Waves
key_points.detail: Particles oscillate perpendicular to the direction of wave propagation (e.g., light waves, waves on a string).

key_points.title: Compressions and Rarefactions
key_points.detail: Longitudinal sound waves propagate by forming regions of high pressure (compressions) and low pressure (rarefactions).

worked_example.problem: A wave is travelling through a medium such that the particles of the medium vibrate perpendicular to the direction of wave propagation. Is it a sound wave?

steps.narration: Question mein diya hai ki particles perpendicular vibrate kar rahe hain.
Aisi wave ko transverse wave kehte hain, lekin sound longitudinal wave hoti hai.

worked_example.answer: No, it is a transverse wave, whereas sound is a longitudinal wave.

worked_example.problem: When you shout, how do the air particles in front of your mouth move to transmit the sound?

steps.narration: Sound ek longitudinal wave hai, isliye hawa ke particles wave ki direction mein hi aage-peeche hilaenge.
steps.math: Motion is parallel to wave direction.

steps.narration: Ye motion compressions aur rarefactions create karega.

worked_example.answer: The air particles vibrate back and forth parallel to the direction of sound, forming compressions and rarefactions.

common_mistakes.title: Thinking sound on a string is just transverse
common_mistakes.explanation: Log sochte hain ki guitar ki aawaz bhi transverse hoti hai. String pe transverse waves banti hain, par hawa mein travel karne wali sound wave humesha longitudinal hoti hai.

recall_questions.q: What type of wave has particles oscillating parallel to the wave direction?
Are sound waves longitudinal or transverse?
What do we call the region of high pressure in a longitudinal wave?

oa_questions.question: Distinguish between longitudinal and transverse waves.
oa_questions.answer: In longitudinal waves, particles oscillate parallel to the wave propagation (e.g., sound). In transverse waves, particles oscillate perpendicular to the wave propagation (e.g., light).
oa_questions.approach: Clearly state the direction of particle oscillation relative to wave travel.

oa_questions.question: Give one example of a transverse wave.
oa_questions.answer: Light waves or waves on a string are transverse waves.
oa_questions.approach: Provide a standard example of transverse waves.
